description: Everything an agent needs on the Notion pages and databases shared with it: search, read pages, content, databases and comments; create pages, databases and rows, edit properties and blocks, comment, and trash or restore, each write counted, governable and read back where Notion allows.

actions.name: search-pages
actions.description: Search the pages shared with the integration by title, most recently edited first. Changes nothing. Returns up to 10 pages per call; pass the response's next_cursor as start_cursor for the next page. Leave query out or empty to list every shared page.

start_cursor.description: The next_cursor of the previous page. Leave out for the first page.

actions.name: search-databases
actions.description: Search the databases shared with the integration by title, most recently edited first. Changes nothing. Returns up to 10 databases per call; pass the response's next_cursor as start_cursor for the next page. Leave query out or empty to list every shared database.

start_cursor.description: The next_cursor of the previous page. Leave out for the first page.

actions.name: get-page
actions.description: Read one page's properties (title, and for a database row every column), parent, url and trash state. Does not return the page's content: use list-block-children with the page id for that. Relation and people values over 25 entries are cut; read them with get-page-property.

actions.name: get-page-property
actions.description: Read one property of a page in full, for values get-page cuts short (long titles and text, relations, people, rollups). property_id is the property's id from get-page with any %XX escapes decoded (for example ':UPp' for '%3AUPp'), or 'title' for the title. Paginated properties return up to 25 items per call; pass next_cursor as start_cursor for the next page.

start_cursor.description: The next_cursor of the previous page. Leave out for the first page.

actions.name: get-block
actions.description: Read one block: its type, its text or other content, whether it has children, and its trash state.

actions.name: list-block-children
actions.description: Read a page's content, or the blocks nested under a block, in order. Returns up to 10 blocks per call; pass next_cursor as start_cursor for the next page. Only the first level: a block with has_children true holds more blocks, read with its own id.

block_id.description: A page id or block id

start_cursor.description: The next_cursor of the previous page. Leave out for the first page.

actions.name: get-database
actions.description: Read one database's title, parent and column schema (each property's name, id, type and options). Fails on a database with more than one data source under the pinned API version.

actions.name: query-database
actions.description: List the rows (pages) of a database, optionally filtered and sorted. Changes nothing. Returns up to 10 rows per call, each with all its properties; pass next_cursor as start_cursor for the next page. Fails on a database with more than one data source under the pinned API version.

filter.description: A Notion database filter: { property, <type>: { condition } }, { timestamp, created_time|last_edited_time: { condition } }, or { and|or: [filters] }, nested at most two levels.

sorts.description: Sort criteria, first one wins: { property, direction } or { timestamp, direction }.

start_cursor.description: The next_cursor of the previous page. Leave out for the first page.

actions.name: list-comments
actions.description: List the open (unresolved) comments on a page or block, oldest first, with each comment's discussion_id for replying. Returns up to 25 comments per call; pass next_cursor as start_cursor for the next page. Needs the integration's read comments capability.

block_id.description: A page id or block id

start_cursor.description: The next_cursor of the previous page. Leave out for the first page.

actions.name: create-page
actions.description: Create one page under a page that is shared with the integration. Read back by page id; the title must match. Limitation: no provider idempotency, so a retry after an unknown outcome can create a second page.

actions.name: create-database
actions.description: Create one database (a table) under a page shared with the integration, with the columns given in properties. Read back by database id; the title must match. Limitation: no provider idempotency, so a retry after an unknown outcome can create a second database.

parent_page_id.description: The page the database is created in

properties.description: The columns, keyed by name, in Notion's property schema form: exactly one { "title": {} } column, plus others such as { "checkbox": {} }, { "select": { "options": [{ "name": "High" }] } }, { "date": {} }.

is_inline.description: Show the database inline in the parent page instead of as a child page

actions.name: create-database-page
actions.description: Add one row (page) to a database, with its property values. database_id must be the hyphenated lowercase id the API returns (search-databases, get-database). Read back by page id; its parent must be that database. Limitation: no provider idempotency, so a retry after an unknown outcome can add a second row.

database_id.description: The database id, hyphenated and lowercase as the API returns it

properties.description: Property values keyed by column name or id, in Notion's page property value form, e.g. { "Name": { "title": [{ "text": { "content": "Ship it" } }] }, "Done": { "checkbox": false } }. Formula, rollup and created/edited columns cannot be set.

actions.name: update-page-properties
actions.description: Set property values on one page: the title of any page, or any column of a database row. Properties left out keep their values. Read back by page id: the page must be live and show the last-edited time this update returned; the read-back does not compare the values, whose names the caller chooses.

properties.description: Property values keyed by name or id, in Notion's page property value form, e.g. { "Done": { "checkbox": true } } or { "title": { "title": [{ "text": { "content": "New title" } }] } }. Rollup, formula and created/edited values cannot be set.

actions.name: archive-page
actions.description: Move one page to the trash. Read back from the page; it must be archived. Limitation: the read-back can match a page that was already archived.

actions.name: restore-page
actions.description: Take one page out of the trash. Read back from the page; it must not be archived. Limitation: the read-back can match a page that was never archived.

actions.name: append-paragraph
actions.description: Add one paragraph to the end of a page. Read back by the new block's id; the text must match. Limitation: no provider idempotency, so a retry after an unknown outcome can add the paragraph twice.

actions.name: append-blocks
actions.description: Add blocks to the end of a page or under a block (or after one of its children with after): paragraphs, headings, bulleted and numbered items, to-dos, toggles, quotes, callouts, code and dividers, text only, no nesting in one call. At most 100 blocks; each counts as one mutation. Read back by the first new block's id; its type and creation time must match. Limitation: no provider idempotency, so a retry after an unknown outcome can add the blocks twice.

block_id.description: The page id, or the block to add children under

children.description: The blocks, in order, e.g. { "type": "to_do", "to_do": { "rich_text": [{ "text": { "content": "Ship" } }], "checked": false } }. The key named by type holds the content.

rich_text.description: Rich text: a list of text runs. Each run's content is at most 2000 characters; Notion takes at most 100 runs.

after.description: Insert after this existing child block instead of at the end

actions.name: update-block-text
actions.description: Replace the text of one block, or tick or untick a to-do. Give exactly one content object, named by the block's current type (get-block shows it); its rich_text replaces the whole text, and checked alone ticks a to-do. Read back by block id: the block must be live and show the last-edited time this update returned; the read-back does not compare the text.

actions.name: delete-block
actions.description: Move one block (a paragraph, heading, to-do or other content block) to the trash. Read back from the block; it must be archived. Limitation: the read-back can match a block that was already archived. Use archive-page for a page.

actions.name: add-comment
actions.description: Start a new comment discussion on a page. Read back by comment id; the text must match. Needs the integration's insert comments capability. Limitation: no provider idempotency, so a retry after an unknown outcome can post the comment twice.

actions.name: reply-to-comment
actions.description: Reply in an existing comment discussion (on a page or on selected text), using a discussion_id from list-comments. Read back by comment id; the discussion and the text must match. Needs the integration's insert comments capability. Limitation: no provider idempotency, so a retry after an unknown outcome can post the reply twice.

discussion_id.description: The discussion id, hyphenated and lowercase as list-comments returns it

actions.name: update-comment
actions.description: Replace the text of one comment the integration itself posted (Notion answers 404 for anyone else's). Read back by comment id; the text must match. Needs the integration's insert comments capability.

actions.name: delete-comment
actions.description: Delete one comment the integration itself posted (Notion answers 404 for anyone else's). Needs the integration's insert comments capability. No read-back: Notion does not document what reading a deleted comment returns, so the receipt is graded acknowledged.
